modules.name: BTF Quantizer
modules.description: Polyphonic quantizer that loads Bmbo Tuning Format (BTF) files and quantizes 1V/oct CV to the loaded tuning.

modules.name: BTF Tuner
modules.description: Analyzes a 1V/octave CV or a real audio signal against a loaded Bmbo Tuning Format (BTF) tuning and displays the current frequency, nearest degree, and cents deviation. Read-only: never quantizes or modifies the input.
